changes.before: Specifically, let \(S_0\) and \(S_1\) be the independently selected vacuum and full-field spaces. The implementation takes \(E_0\) and its normalised ground-state vector from \(H_0|_{S_0}\), and \(E_1\) from the lowest eigenvalue of \(H_1|_{S_1}\). It extends the vacuum vector by zero to a vector \(u_0\) in the common 225-determinant parent basis. With \(V=H_1-H_0\) and the retained inactive-plus-nuclear endpoint increment \(\Delta c\), it evaluates \(D_{\mathrm{ind}}=u_0^{T}Vu_0+\Delta c\) and \(I_{\mathrm{ind}}=E_1-E_0+\Delta c-D_{\mathrm{ind}}\). Thus the static expectation uses the vacuum state in \(S_0\), whereas the full-field energy uses \(S_1\). The reported component errors subtract the exact-parent static and induction components and use the retained Hartree-to-kcal/mol conversion. This is the independently selected endpoint implementation, distinct from the common-space pooled calculation.
changes.after: Specifically, let \(S_0\) and \(S_1\) be the independently selected vacuum and full-field spaces. To distinguish the implementation from the total Hamiltonians \(H(s)\) above, write its scalar-stripped parent matrices as \(K_s=H(s)-c_s\mathbf{1}\), where the retained inactive-plus-nuclear scalar is \(c_s=c_0+s\Delta c\), and set \(W=K_1-K_0\). Only the inactive-plus-nuclear scalar is removed; inactive-core interactions remain in the effective integrals. The implementation takes the lowest eigenvalue \(\varepsilon_0\) and its normalised ground-state vector from \(K_0|_{S_0}\), and \(\varepsilon_1\) from \(K_1|_{S_1}\). It extends the vacuum vector by zero to \(w_0\) in the common 225-determinant parent basis and evaluates \(D_{\mathrm{ind}}=w_0^{T}Ww_0+\Delta c\) and \(I_{\mathrm{ind}}=\varepsilon_1-\varepsilon_0+\Delta c-D_{\mathrm{ind}}\). Thus the static expectation uses the vacuum state in \(S_0\), whereas the full-field energy uses \(S_1\). The scalar increment is restored once in the static component and once in the total endpoint difference from which that static component is subtracted. Equivalently, with total selected-space endpoint energies \(E_s^{\mathrm{sel}}=\varepsilon_s+c_s\) and the earlier total perturbation \(V=W+\Delta c\mathbf{1}\), the same definitions are \(D_{\mathrm{ind}}=w_0^{T}Vw_0\) and \(I_{\mathrm{ind}}=E_1^{\mathrm{sel}}-E_0^{\mathrm{sel}}-D_{\mathrm{ind}}\), without any additional scalar increment. The common-space pooled calculation uses the same scalar restoration with one selected space at both endpoints. Reported component errors subtract the exact-parent static and induction components and use the retained Hartree-to-kcal/mol conversion.
